title: Flight price prediction
summary: Tells you when to book flights for the best price.
whyTempting: Airfares are confusing and people want deals.
whyItFails: Feature, not company. Search engines add predictions. Low margins. Affiliate fees are thin. Data access. Fare data is expensive.
whatWouldChange: Little has changed; best as a feature.

attempts.notes: Airfare prediction; bought for $115 million in 2008, predictions dropped from Bing Travel in 2014.

reasons.detail: Feature, not company: Search engines add predictions.
Low margins: Affiliate fees are thin.
Data access: Fare data is expensive.
